voice.title: Voice Command
voice.subtitle: Press to speak — we'll turn it into an action
voice.simulatedNotice: Your browser doesn't support speech recognition — type the command and press Analyze
voice.realMicNotice: Real speech recognition via your browser — speak naturally and we'll turn it into a reminder
voice.micError: Couldn't access the microphone. Make sure it's allowed.
voice.micPermissionDenied: The browser blocked microphone access — click the lock icon next to the address bar and allow the microphone for this site.
voice.micNoSpeech: We didn't hear anything. Make sure your microphone is on and try again.
voice.notUnderstood: We couldn't understand a clear command. Try e.g. "Remind me to call Ahmad tomorrow at 11".

verification.title: Account verification
verification.subtitle: Your account is only shown as a verified lawyer in the directory after an admin reviews and approves your details.

statusText.pending: We received your verification request and an admin is reviewing it. You'll be notified of the decision.
statusText.approved: Your account is verified and your profile appears in the lawyer directory.
statusText.rejected: Your verification request was rejected. You can update your details and resubmit.
statusText.more_info_requested: An admin asked for more information. Update your details below and resubmit.

verification.infoHelp: Mention your bar registration year, workplace and anything that helps the admin verify you. Don't upload ID numbers or sensitive documents here.
verification.infoPlaceholder: e.g. Registered with the Jordan Bar Association since 2016, office in Amman - Shmeisani...
verification.saved: Your details were submitted for review.
verification.failed: Couldn't submit your details. Please try again.
verification.tooShort: Write enough information to verify you (at least 20 characters).
verification.hiddenNotice: Bar numbers and this information are private: only you and admins can see them.
verification.banner: Your verification status: {status}. You won't appear as a verified lawyer in the directory until an admin approves your details.
